Landed · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-27T22:47Z

PR #26906 merged at `216a39e7`, which is an ancestor of `origin/main`. On all 9 paths the PR touched, the merge tree matches the accepted head `96844466` byte for byte.

The view and object publish doors (`PUT /api/v1/meta/view`, `PUT /api/v1/meta/object`) now run `validateChartBindings`. A list view whose `chart.dataset` names no declared dataset, or whose `chart.dimensions` / `chart.values` names a dimension or measure its dataset does not declare, is refused `422` with the verdict `os validate` gives: `chart-dataset-unknown`, `chart-dimension-unknown` or `chart-measure-unknown`. This holds for the view item `config`, the flattened list overlay and an object's own `listViews`. `os validate` / `os build` now also report the two shapes they used to skip. Drafts are not gated.

`@objectstack/lint` is minor, with a BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`. The card closed through `Fixes #26847`, and this seat removes `pm:dispatched`.
